name: Thraka/SadConsole
description: A C#/.NET cross-platform terminal and ASCII console game engine targeting MonoGame and SFML, featuring tile-based fonts, GUI controls, entity systems, and importers for DOS ANSI and RexPaint formats. Actively maintained through .NET 10.
score_rationale: 1.4k-star .NET ASCII/terminal game engine actively maintained through 2026, the primary choice for C# roguelike developers.
summary: .NET terminal and ASCII game engine with GUI and entity system support
